products.name: Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune Migration Program — Commercial
products.short_description: The end-to-end Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune migration program — assessment, wave planning, identity/enrollment readiness, app and policy rebuild, coexistence, ringed cutover per platform, and clean Workspace ONE decommission. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move your whole fleet from Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune — without losing a device or an app

Migrating an enterprise off VMware Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune is one of the highest-risk endpoint projects there is: thousands of enrolled Windows, iOS, Android, and Mac devices, hundreds of apps and profiles, and zero tolerance for a user losing email or access mid-day. Done ad hoc it stalls in finger-pointing between teams. This solution is the end-to-end Workspace ONE to Intune migration program — assessment and wave planning, identity and enrollment readiness, app and policy rebuild, coexistence, ringed cutover per platform, and clean Workspace ONE decommission — as one repeatable, documented operating model.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the migration model end to end, the per-platform approach (Windows, iOS/iPadOS, Android, macOS), coexistence vs. cutover, how identity/enrollment/apps/policies move, and the program operating model (roles, waves, KPIs).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing, Entra ID, Workspace ONE admin/export access, per-platform enrollment prerequisites, device/app inventory, executive sponsorship, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: assess and inventory the Workspace ONE estate, plan waves, stand up Intune enrollment and identity, rebuild apps and policies, run coexistence, cut over by ring/platform, validate, decommission Workspace ONE, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — migration-readiness discovery, per-device migration/enrollment validation, a program-wide migration status and parity report, safe remediation of failed migrations, and a wave/ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Your entire fleet moved from Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune — Windows, iOS, Android, and Mac re-enrolled, apps and policies rebuilt and validated, and Workspace ONE decommissioned — run as one repeatable program, proven on a pilot wave before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WS1PROG-Discovery.ps1 — Read-only Discovery baseline for a Workspace ONE -> Microsoft Intune migration program
    • WS1PROG-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation helpers for failed Workspace ONE -> Intune migrations
    • WS1PROG-Report.ps1 — Read-only program/wave status dashboard for a Workspace ONE -> Intune migration
    • WS1PROG-Set-WaveTargeting.ps1 — Build the migration wave plan and the Entra targeting groups
    • WS1PROG-Validation.ps1 — Read-only per-device / per-wave migration validation for Workspace ONE -> Intune

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
